function.name: add_item
function.description: Add one menu line to the order. Call once per distinct menu line. Only pass options the customer actually asked for (or that a slang alias implies); omitted options use the menu defaults.

shots_delta.description: Extra (+) or fewer (-) espresso shots relative to the standard recipe, e.g. 1 = one extra shot, -1 = one shot fewer.

function.name: modify_item
function.description: Change options of an item already in the current order.

item_index.description: 1-based line number in the current order.

function.name: remove_item
function.description: Remove an item from the current order.

item_index.description: 1-based line number in the current order.

function.name: ask_clarification
function.description: Ask the customer a question instead of acting. Use when the request is ambiguous, impossible under the menu rules, or not on the menu.

question.description: Question to say to the customer, in Korean.

function.name: confirm_order
function.description: The customer has finished ordering; confirm and place the current order.
